result: Per-example prediction outputs from the cross-encoder paraphrase model evaluated on the GLUE MRPC validation set. Each row corresponds to one sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores two fields: prediction (binary predicted label, where 1 indicates paraphrase and 0 indicates not_paraphrase) and score (the model’s positive-class score for the pair; in this notebook, the softmax probability of the paraphrase class when logits are returned). This dataset is an intermediate inference artifact used to persist row-level model outputs, trace them back to the source MRPC examples, inspect correct and incorrect predictions, and support downstream summary evaluation such as accuracy, F1, and the classification report.

Binary paraphrase predictions for the GLUE MRPC validation set, generated by encoding each sentence pair with sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 using max_seq_length=64, computing the cosine similarity between the normalized sentence1 and sentence2 embeddings, and applying a threshold of 0.80. This record list contains one row per validation example with a single field, prediction, where 1 indicates predicted paraphrase and 0 indicates predicted non-paraphrase. Each record is linked back to the corresponding source example in glue_mrpc_validation and to the two embedding lists sentence-transformers-sentence-1-max64 and sentence-transformers-sentence-2-max64. In this workflow, the dataset serves as the stored model output used for downstream evaluation, error analysis, and experiment summary reporting.

Per-example prediction dataset for the GLUE MRPC validation split, produced by applying the typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli model as a zero-shot paraphrase detector. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores: prediction (binary paraphrase decision, where 1 indicates paraphrase and 0 indicates not_paraphrase), score_12 (entailment logit minus max(contradiction, neutral) for sentence1 -> sentence2), and score_21 (the same score for sentence2 -> sentence1). The final prediction is derived from the average of the two directional scores. In this workflow, this dataset captures the model’s per-example outputs for downstream evaluation, inspection of mistakes, and construction of the overall summary metrics.

mrpc_gate_margin_prediction is a per-example prediction dataset derived from the GLUE MRPC validation split. For each validation pair (sentence1, sentence2), the notebook runs the NLI model typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli in both input orders, sentence1→sentence2 and sentence2→sentence1, and stores the resulting decision signals used for paraphrase classification. The dataset has four fields: prediction (final binary paraphrase prediction, 1 for paraphrase and 0 for not paraphrase), margin_12 (entailment logit minus contradiction logit for sentence1 paired with sentence2), margin_21 (the same margin for the reversed order), and gate (boolean flag that is true only when neither direction’s argmax label is contradiction). The final prediction is produced by requiring gate = true and the average of margin_12 and margin_21 to be greater than 0. This dataset serves as the main intermediate output of the workflow: it preserves the model’s directional margin scores and final gated prediction for each MRPC example, and it is then used to compute the summary accuracy, F1, and classification report.

Per-example inference results from the Hugging Face model textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC run on the glue_mrpc_validation dataset. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from the MRPC validation split and stores two fields: prediction, a binary label produced by thresholding the model’s paraphrase probability at 0.70; and paraphrase_probs, the softmax probability assigned to the positive paraphrase class. Records are linked back to the matching input example in glue_mrpc_validation. This dataset serves as the main prediction output of the workflow and is used for downstream evaluation, error analysis, and creation of the run-level summary dataset.

Per-example prediction dataset for the GLUE MRPC validation split generated with the cross-encoder/quora-distilroberta-base model using symmetric inference over sentence order. Each record corresponds to one input sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores: y_pred (final binary paraphrase prediction after averaging forward and reverse scores and thresholding at 0.5), orig_score (positive-class probability for the original order: sentence1, sentence2), and rev_score (positive-class probability for the reversed order: sentence2, sentence1). This dataset is used as the main prediction artifact in the workflow: it captures model outputs for every validation example, supports error analysis and inspection of order sensitivity, and serves as an input to the downstream summary dataset that reports overall accuracy, F1, and the classification report.

Experiment-level evaluation summary for the notebook run using the cross-encoder/quora-distilroberta-base model on the GLUE MRPC validation split with a paraphrase decision threshold of 0.65 applied to the positive softmax score. This dataset contains a single summary record with the fields: accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string produced by sklearn, summarizing precision, recall, f1-score, and support for the not_paraphrase and paraphrase classes). It is derived from the full glue_mrpc_validation dataset and the corresponding per-example predictions stored in distilbert_quora_softmax_prediction, and its role is to capture the overall performance of this experiment in a compact, queryable form for comparison, tracking, and documentation.

Per-example prediction outputs from google/flan-t5-small on the GLUE MRPC validation set using a yes/no paraphrase prompt evaluated in both original and swapped sentence order. Each record is aligned to one input example from glue_mrpc_validation and contains: prediction (binary paraphrase decision after averaging forward and swapped logits), yes_logits (forward-order logit for “yes”), no_logits (forward-order logit for “no”), swapped_yes_logits (swapped-order logit for “yes”), and swapped_no_logits (swapped-order logit for “no”). This dataset is used as the intermediate model-output table in the workflow, supporting order-symmetric paraphrase prediction, error analysis, and computation of final evaluation metrics in the summary dataset.

Per-example prediction outputs for the GLUE MRPC validation set generated with the textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC classifier under two sentence orders. Each record corresponds to one validation example and contains three fields: prediction (final binary label after averaging both orders and thresholding at 0.5), pos_probs (paraphrase probability for the original input order: sentence1, sentence2), and swap_pos_probs (paraphrase probability for the swapped order: sentence2, sentence1). This dataset is the intermediate prediction table used to capture order-sensitive model scores, produce the bidirectional averaged decision, and feed the final evaluation summary.

Aggregate evaluation summary for the neutral-penalized margin MRPC experiment. This dataset contains a single summary record computed from the GLUE MRPC validation set and the derived mrpc_neutral_penalty_prediction records. Its fields are: accuracy (float, overall prediction accuracy), f1 (float, F1 score for the paraphrase class), and classification_report (string, full sklearn classification report with per-class precision, recall, F1, and support). In this workflow, it serves as the compact experiment-level output used to record and retrieve overall model performance after scoring sentence pairs with the MNLI model and converting the bidirectional entailment-vs.-non-entailment margin into paraphrase predictions.
